_readme: Put this object in the accounts field of box.json or box.local.json and describe YOUR accounts, then delete every
channel you do not use. This file is vocabulary, not secrets - the tokens and passwords live
Credentials belong in the gitignored credentials field of box.local.json, keyed by channel and account id.
Shape: channel -> list of accounts. The DEFAULT account of a channel keeps the bare channel
name ('github'); every other account gets an @-suffixed one ('github@bob'), which is also how
its signals namespace themselves ('github@bob.stars.<repo>'). Give each channel at most one
Fields: id (the channel suffix), user (a users.id from Settings -> Users, which is what makes
a signal owned by a person), login (the platform handle; empty means placeholder and pulls
skip it), and then the per-channel extras below.
NO FILE AT ALL IS A SUPPORTED STATE. A Box with no accounts.json simply has no channel pulls,
and core never reads it at all. Only an adopted app that pulls from outside looks here; the
channels below are examples of that, not a set this repo ships.
Nothing reads a key starting with _ , because every reader looks a channel up by name - which
is what lets this example carry its own notes.

github._note: repos: owner/name to track stars and traffic for. org: an org to snapshot alongside the user. ossPrQuery: a GitHub search query counting external PRs you authored.

blog._note: feed: the RSS/Atom URL of YOUR blog. There is no default - without it the blog pull logs that no feed is configured and does nothing. Point at the canonical host: a feed URL that redirects costs a round trip on every pull. GA4 is optional and configured in credentials.json.

substack._note: publication: the ORIGIN this account publishes to. Not derivable from the login - the subdomain is independent of the handle, and a custom domain answers the API on that domain instead.

hackernews._note: mentionTerms: what a stranger would type when talking about you - product and company names. Separate from login, which is only who you POST as. Empty is fine and means you only get your own submissions back.

reddit._note: Needs the external stealth-browser gateway this repo does not ship (docs/FIELD-TEST.md). The topic radar's subs and keywords are NOT here - they are config/reddit-radar.json.
